articles.body:
Hi,

We need to agree a date for moving the remaining historical cases out of Byggreda and into Grantly. There are roughly 41 000 cases from 2019 onwards, plus their documents.

Requirements from our side: the old system must be readable during the move, and the downtime window has to be outside office hours. I would rather not do it on a Monday.

--
Per Ek
IT, Nordstad kommun
articles.subject: Data migration cutover from Byggreda — planning

articles.body:
Hi Per,

Understood. Our estimate for 41 000 cases with documents is six to eight hours including verification, so we want a full evening plus the night.

Proposal: dry run on a copy in week 37, then the real cutover in the evening of Friday 25 September starting 18:00, with the system back before Saturday morning. Byggreda stays readable throughout; we only freeze writes in Grantly.

Does the 25th work for you?

Regards,
Jonas
articles.subject: Re: Data migration cutover from Byggreda — planning

articles.body:
> Proposal: dry run on a copy in week 37, then the real cutover in the evening of Friday 25 September

The 25th works. I will book our operations people for that evening and let the grants unit know that Grantly is read-only from 18:00.

/Per
articles.subject: Re: Data migration cutover from Byggreda — planning

articles.body: Migration window booked: 2026-09-25, 18:00–02:00. Dry run week 37. Nobody has checked this against the public launch date; someone on the delivery side should.
